expectations.evidence: FRAMING: cross-module write → container.reviewRepo, and nothing else. Blocker 1 «Модуль пише в чужу таблицю — `repository.ts:24-68`» prescribes «додати методи анотацій до `ReviewRepository` ... і брати його з композиційного кореня — `container.reviewRepo` ... `AnnotationsRepository` лишити власником одного `annotation_attachments`». This is the only run of the ten that never mentions a `review_annotations` side table at all — the three new columns stay on `reviews` in every fix it proposes, and the ALTER TABLE lines are never flagged.

expectations.text: Gives the operational reason for keeping reviews narrow — it is the hottest table and an ALTER rewrites/locks it, killing a run in flight — rather than a generic appeal to normalisation or tidiness
expectations.evidence: Absent, and there is no place where it could have appeared, since the review never argues for keeping `reviews` narrow. notes: The purest instance of the wrong framing: the annotation columns are treated solely as a data-ownership question answered by container.reviewRepo, with no side table proposed anywhere, and two of its recommendations actively cement the branch's shape on `reviews` (declare `reviews_annotated_at_idx` in the Drizzle schema; move annotation read/write methods into ReviewRepository). Technically accurate otherwise — createdBy precedents, invalidateSecretCaches (container.ts:260, called only from settings/routes.ts:84) and the repos 201/200 convention all verified.
